{{Quote|Have TIE bomber squadron Theta support the corvettes.|Lumiya|<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire">{{GalaxyCite|3|Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire}}</ref>}}
'''Theta Squadron''', or '''TIE bomber squadron Theta''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] that was under the command of [[Lumiya]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]], following the decimation of [[Lumiya's fleet|her fleet]] in the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. This [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] unit participated in an [[Assault on Epsilon Nine|assault]] led by Lumiya on the [[Communications Research Station|Communications Research]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Epsilon Nine]].<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire" />
